verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Postman can generate/register MCP servers (docs-7, docs-9) and has an AI 'Agent Mode' (docs-8), but there is no documentation or hands-on evidence that Postman itself acts as an MCP client, letting users plug in external MCP servers so its AI/tools can consume them. Missing for 10: explicit MCP-client integration inside Postman's AI/Agent Mode, UI/config for adding external MCP servers, and any hands-on proof of tool invocation from a connected MCP server.
